title: Injective resolutions of a short exact sequence of bounded below complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with enough injectives [def-sp-abelian]. Let $0\to A^\bullet\xrightarrow{f}B^\bullet\xrightarrow{g}C^\bullet\to0$ be a sequence of cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$ with $A^n=B^n=C^n=0$ for $n<0$ which is short exact in each degree. Then there exist cochain complexes $I_1^\bullet,I_2^\bullet,I_3^\bullet$ of injective objects of $\mathcal A$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions] with $I_k^n=0$ for $n<0$, morphisms of complexes $j:I_1^\bullet\to I_2^\bullet$, $q:I_2^\bullet\to I_3^\bullet$ such that $0\to I_1^n\xrightarrow{j^n}I_2^n\xrightarrow{q^n}I_3^n\to0$ is short exact for every $n$, and quasi-isomorphisms of complexes $\varphi_1:A^\bullet\to I_1^\bullet$, $\varphi_2:B^\bullet\to I_2^\bullet$, $\varphi_3:C^\bullet\to I_3^\bullet$ (morphisms of complexes inducing isomorphisms on all cohomology objects) with $\varphi_2\circ f=j\circ\varphi_1$ and $\varphi_3\circ g=q\circ\varphi_2$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 013T (lemma-injective-resolution-ses, line 6571), main assertion together with part (2) (if A^n = B^n = C^n = 0 for n < 0 one may take I_j^n = 0 for n < 0); injective resolutions of complexes in the sense of Section Tag 013G; proof Steps 1-2 (pushout along A -> I, then the termwise split case with I_2^n = I_1^n (+) I_3^n)
